blocks.text: Contact Koojo powder coating by phone at (905) 876-7060, by email at sales@koojopowdercoating.com, or in person at 10874 Steeles Ave E, Milton, ON L9T 2X8. The front office is open Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 5 PM, and our team is on hand to help throughout those hours.

Fabricators, manufacturers, contractors, public clients and individuals have trusted us with over 10,000 coated items since 2012. Below you will find every way to reach us, how drop-off and pickup work, and what happens after you get in touch. Every detail here is current and checked by our own team.

How Do I Contact Koojo?

Call during business hours for the quickest answer, email photos and sizes when you want a written reply, or visit the shop with a part. All three reach the same small team that quotes, coats and inspects your work.

Most local customers phone first to check timing, then email drawings or photos so we can price the job accurately. If you call outside opening hours, leave a message; after-hours messages are returned the next working day. You can also use the contact form at the bottom of this page, which goes straight to our front office. However you reach Koojo, the person who answers can tell you where your parts stand.
Contact Details at a Glance
Here is every detail you need in one place: phone number, email address, shop address and hours. Save this page, or add our number to your phone, so the right contact is always one tap away.

blocks.text: When you contact us by email, include photos, sizes and quantity to save a round of questions. The Google Map below gives turn-by-turn directions.
Drop-Off and Pickup, Step by Step

Drop-off and pickup follow eight simple steps, from your first call to collecting finished parts. Following them keeps your visit short and makes sure nothing is missed when your parts reach our shop.
Call Ahead
Before you visit, contact Koojo to book a time, especially for long or heavy items.
Prepare and Label Parts
Remove loose debris, label each part and mark any areas that must stay bare.
Plan Your Route
Use the map above for directions to our shop on Steeles Avenue East in Milton.
Arrive During Opening Hours
Bring parts any weekday between 7 AM and 5 PM. Ask about parking and loading when you call.
Receiving Check
When you reach Koojo, we count the parts, note their condition and confirm the finish with you.
Coating and Curing
Standard orders are prepped, coated, cured and inspected within 48 hours.
Ready Notice
We call or email the moment parts are ready, so you can arrange your pickup schedule.
Pickup or Delivery
Collect in person or ask about delivery options when you book. Questions at any step? Contact Koojo powder coating and we will help.
Which Contact Method Is Best?

It depends on what you need when you contact us. Phone suits quick questions, email suits drawings and photos, the quote form suits pricing and a visit suits colour choices. The table shows when each works best.

Calling About an Industry Job?
Each industry has its own page explaining how we handle that kind of work. Read yours before you call, and have the details in the card ready, so your first conversation is quick and useful.

Drop-Off vs Pickup vs On-Site Blasting
You can bring parts to us, have us collect them, or, for items too big to move, book mobile sandblasting on site. The table compares the three so you can pick the one that fits your job.
Whichever option you choose, reach Koojo first so we can plan.

Many of our best jobs began when a customer chose to contact Koojo with a quick phone call. These three case studies show where that first conversation led, with specs, photos and test readings for each finished part.

Response Times and Lead Times

If you contact us during opening hours, calls are answered live, and emails are usually answered the same or next working day. Once parts arrive, standard orders are ready in 48 hours, with larger jobs confirmed in writing.
Getting in touch costs nothing. Early contact helps most for big or urgent jobs, because we can reserve oven time before your parts arrive.
How to Get a Price
The fastest way to a price is our online form. Add photos, sizes, quantity and the finish you want, and we will send a written estimate with prep, powder and timing included.
Request a [powder coating quote](/get-a-quote) online, or contact Koojo powder coating by phone to talk it through.
Contact Koojo Powder Coating: FAQs

Short answer: contact Koojo by phone, email or a visit during opening hours, and a real person will help. These answers cover hours, visits, after-hours contact, large drop-offs and the areas we serve.

blocks.a: Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 5 PM. We are closed on weekends.

blocks.q: Can I visit without an appointment?
blocks.a: Yes, during opening hours, but calling first means the right person is free to meet you.

blocks.q: How do I reach you after hours?
blocks.a: Email sales@koojopowdercoating.com or leave a voicemail, and we will reply on the next working day.

blocks.q: Can I drop off very big items?
blocks.a: Yes. Call ahead so we can plan unloading; single parts weighing up to 6,000 lb fit our oven.
